titleByLocale.fr: Thérapeute de beauté et de massage (h/f/d)

jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

  • You are a passionate and highly skilled professional with a strong background in beauty and aesthetics.

  • Your primary focus is on delivering an exceptional range of beauty treatments, including waxing, manicure, pedicure, make-up, and advanced facial treatments, executed with the highest level of precision, care, and attention to detail.

  • With your refined technique and natural sense of service, you create a personalized and indulgent experience, ensuring each guest feels truly pampered, valued, and at ease.

  • Knowledge of relaxing massage techniques is considered an asset, allowing you to further enhance the holistic wellness experience we offer.

  • You thrive in a collaborative Spa environment, contributing to a seamless operation and upholding the highest standards of excellence and guest satisfaction.


• What you bring to the job

For this diverse and rewarding position, you ideally bring the following:

  • A professional qualification with solid practical experience in the above-mentioned areas, preferably within a 5-star luxury hospitality environment.

  • Excellent language skills in English; additional knowledge of Italian and German is highly desirable.

  • A natural flair for sales, combined with strong interpersonal skills and a genuine passion for guest interaction.

  • A high level of commitment, resilience, and flexibility in a dynamic environment.

  • A well-groomed appearance and impeccable manners, reflecting the standards of a luxury establishment.


Our offer

  • Fixed-term seasonal contract from the end of November 2026 until the end of March 2027, with the opportunity to return for future seasons.

  • 5-day working week, averaging 43.5 hours.

  • 5 weeks of holiday and 6 public holidays per year (pro rata).

  • 13th salary from the start date (pro rata temporis).

  • Accommodation available upon request in one of our attractive staff residences.

  • Dining facilities in our modern staff restaurant.

  • The opportunity to work in a prestigious environment with excellent development prospects.


If you are looking for an interesting, challenging, and varied role in a dynamic environment and would like to join a well-established team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.


Recruitment Fraud Warning

Badrutt's Palace Hotel will never request payment or financial information during the recruitment process. All official communication is sent exclusively from email addresses ending in @badruttspalace.com. If you receive any request for payment or suspicious communication, please disregard it and contact us directly through our official website.

As part of our Palace Coiffeur Team, you will contribute to delivering an exceptional and highly personalised experience to our international guests. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Providing professional, personalised consultations and hair services tailored to our guests’ individual needs and preferences

  • Performing colouring services with confidence, precision and a high level of technical expertise

  • Recommending and selling selected premium wellness, beauty and haircare products

  • Ensuring consistently high standards of service, presentation and guest care in line with the standards of a five-star luxury hotel


• What you bring to the job

For this varied and guest-focused position, you ideally bring:

  • Several years of professional experience as a Hair Stylist / Hairdresser, preferably within a luxury hospitality, high-end salon or international environment

  • Strong expertise in professional haircare and colouring techniques

  • Very good command of English; German, Italian and any additional languages are considered an advantage

  • A natural ability to understand and anticipate guests’ individual needs

  • A strong service orientation and passion for creating memorable guest experiences

  • Excellent teamwork and interpersonal skills

  • Flexibility, resilience and a high level of commitment

  • A polished and professional appearance, combined with excellent manners and discretion


Our offer

  • A fixed-term seasonal position from 18.12.2026 to 03.01.2027

  • An average 5-day working week of 43.5 hours

  • 5 weeks of annual leave and 6 public holidays per year, calculated pro rata

  • 13th-month salary from the start of employment, calculated pro rata temporis

  • Accommodation in one of our attractive staff residences, subject to availability and upon request

  • Meals available at our modern staff restaurant

  • The opportunity to work in an exceptional international luxury hospitality environment

  • A dynamic workplace offering professional development opportunities


If you are looking for a rewarding, challenging and varied position in a dynamic luxury environment and would like to become part of a dedicated and well-established team, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.

jobs.title: Night Auditor (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Was Sie bei uns bewirken

Als Night Auditor sind Sie während der Nacht eine wichtige Ansprechperson für unsere internationalen Gäste und stellen einen reibungslosen Ablauf der Front-Office-Prozesse sowie die Einhaltung unserer hohen Service- und Qualitätsstandards sicher.

Sie ergänzen unser Front Office Team und sind insbesondere für folgende • Aufgaben verantwortlich:

  • Sie empfangen unsere internationalen Gäste professionell und herzlich, führen Check-ins und Check-outs durch und kümmern sich individuell um ihre Anliegen und Wünsche.

  • Sie gewährleisten während der Nacht einen erstklassigen Gästeservice entsprechend den hohen Standards eines internationalen 5-Sterne-Luxushotels.

  • Sie übernehmen die anfallenden • Aufgaben am Front Office, an der Kasse und im Backoffice und sind für die Durchführung des Tagesabschlusses sowie die Kontrolle der relevanten Buchungen, Umsätze und Kassen verantwortlich.

  • Sie werden eng mit Concierge, Housekeeping, Security und weiteren operativen Abteilungen zusammenarbeiten und unterstützen bei Bedarf das Front Office, Guest Relations und Guest Experience Team.


• Ihr Profil

Für diese sehr abwechslungsreiche Position bringen Sie idealerweise folgendes mit:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung in der Hotellerie oder Abschluss einer Hotelfachschule.

  • Mindestens 2-3 Jahre Berufserfahrung am Front Office, idealerweise als Night Auditor oder in einer vergleichbaren Position in der 5-Sterne-Luxushotellerie.

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse der operativen und administrativen Front Office Abläufe.

  • Erfahrung mit Tagesabschlüssen, Kassenführung und der Kontrolle von Front Office Transaktionen

  • Flexibilität und gute Kenntnisse der Arbeitsprozesse im Front Office Bereich.

  • Sehr gute Sprachkenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch, Italienisch- oder Russischkenntnisse von Vorteil.

  • Gute EDV-Anwenderkenntnisse der MS-Office Programme.

  • Tadellose Umgangsformen und gepflegtes Erscheinungsbild.

  • Hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit im Nachtdienst.

  • Ausgeprägte Teamorientierung und gleichzeitig die Fähigkeit, Entscheidungen selbständig zu treffen.

Unser Angebot

  • Befristete Saisonstelle von Ende November 2026 bis Ende März 2027.

  • 5-Tage Woche im Schnitt bei 43,5 Stunden.

  • 5 Wochen Ferien und 6 Feiertage pro Jahr.

  • 13. Gehalt ab Eintritt (pro rata temporis).

  • Auf Wunsch zu Beginn Unterkunft in einem unserer neuen Mitarbeiterhäuser.

  • Verpflegungsmöglichkeit im neuen, modernen Mitarbeiter Restaurant.

  • Arbeit in einem attraktiven Umfeld mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Wenn Sie eine interessante, anspruchsvolle und vielseitige Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld schätzen und sich einem gut eingespielten Team anschliessend möchten, dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre vollständige Online Bewerbung.

Warnhinweis vor Recruiting-Betrug

Das Badrutt’s Palace Hotel wird im Rahmen des Rekrutierungsprozesses niemals Zahlungen oder finanzielle Informationen verlangen. Die gesamte offizielle Kommunikation erfolgt ausschliesslich über E-Mail-Adressen mit der Endung @badruttspalace.com.

jobs.title: Chef de Partie (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

As a Chef de Partie, you will play a key role in ensuring the highest culinary standards and delivering an exceptional dining experience. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Preparing, cooking, and presenting high-quality dishes within your assigned kitchen section.

  • Ensuring consistent quality through the careful selection, preparation, and handling of fresh ingredients.

  • Supporting the development of seasonal menus and contributing creative ideas to enhance our culinary offering.

  • Maintaining the highest standards of food hygiene, safety, and cleanliness in accordance with HACCP regulations.

  • Working closely with the Executive Chef, Sous Chefs, and the wider kitchen team to ensure a smooth and efficient operation.

  • Assisting in the training and support of junior kitchen team members when required.

  • Managing your section efficiently while maintaining excellent quality, organization, and attention to detail.

  • Leading the Brand & Marketing team, you will foster a culture of brand excellence, cultural awareness, and creativity.

  • You will further develop the hotel's distinctive social media and content strategy, placing cultural relevance and a clearly defined luxury brand code at the heart of every initiative.

  • As the owner of the CRM strategy, you will strengthen guest relationships, drive loyalty, and create long-term value across the luxury guest journey.

  • Relevant KPIs will be defined, monitored, and managed by you to ensure transparency, measure performance, and deliver sustainable business impact.

  • You will lead external agencies and strategic partners with a clear focus on quality, creativity, and brand consistency.

  • You have a refined understanding of ultra-luxury, aesthetics, language, and brand excellence.

  • Several years of experience in a senior Brand and/or Marketing leadership role within a premium or luxury environment enable you to shape brands with confidence and strategic vision.

  • You have a proven track record of leading teams at management or executive level.

  • Your expertise spans the full digital ecosystem, including social media, content, performance marketing, web, and CRM.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, combined with strong decision-making and execution capabilities, enables you to deliver measurable business impact.

  • You are confident in managing and influencing senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • You communicate fluently in English; proficiency in German is an advantage.

  • You thrive in a demanding, seasonal luxury hospitality environment and embrace the pace and expectations that come with it.

jobs.title: Assistant Head of Technical Services (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

As Assistant Head of Technical Services, you support the Head of Technical Services in the operational management and ongoing development of all technical areas within our property. You help ensure the reliable, safe, and efficient operation of our infrastructure and assume responsibility for the department in their absence.

  • Coordination and supervision of daily technical operations, maintenance activities, and repairs.

  • Involvement in the planning and implementation of maintenance, investment, renovation, and construction projects.

  • Support in the organisation of the technical team’s daily assignments and in leading and developing team members.

  • Deputising for the Head of Technical Services during their absence.

  • Coordination and supervision of external service providers and contractors.

  • Support with cost monitoring, procurement, and investment planning.

  • Ensuring compliance with legal requirements, safety standards, and internal policies.

  • Close collaboration with all departments and contribution to the continuous improvement of technical processes, energy efficiency, and resource management.


• What you bring to the job

  • Completed technical training, ideally complemented by further education in building services engineering, facility management, or a related discipline.

  • Several years of professional experience in technical services or facility management, ideally within the hospitality sector or a similarly complex environment.

  • Experience in coordinating employees or small teams; initial leadership experience is an advantage.

  • Broad technical knowledge of building services, maintenance, energy efficiency, occupational safety, and technical infrastructure.

  • Experience in supporting or coordinating maintenance, renovation, or construction projects.

  • A structured, hands-on, and solution-oriented approach, combined with strong organisational and communication skills.

  • Confident use of digital tools.

  • A recognised qualification as a Safety Officer (SIBE) and/or Contact Person for Occupational Safety (KOPAS) is required.

  • A combination of at least two of the following languages is required: English, German, and Italian.

  • Please note: You must be a Swiss or EU national to apply for this position.


Our offer

  • Permanent position, starting date by arrangement

  • 5-day working week averaging 43.5 hours, with 5 weeks' holiday and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th month's salary from the start of employment (pro rata temporis).

  • To begin with, accommodation in one of our new staff houses.

  • Meals available in our new and modern staff restaurant.

  • Opportunity to work in an attractive environment with development and career growth opportunities.

Your key responsibilities

  • As a painter, you will be responsible for painting, decorating, and minor repair work throughout the hotel as well as in the staff housing, ensuring that all areas consistently meet our high standards.

  • You will carry out high-quality interior and exterior painting and decorating work, including the professional preparation of surfaces through filling, sanding, priming, painting, and coating.

  • You will perform regular inspections and touch-up work in guest rooms, bathrooms, public areas, and back-of-house spaces to maintain an impeccable appearance and ensure the highest quality standards.

  • You will carry out minor repair and maintenance work on walls, ceilings, woodwork, and other painted or coated surfaces, selecting and using appropriate materials and techniques.

  • You will work closely with the Technical Services team and support painting, decorating, and finishing work during renovations, seasonal preparations, special projects, and events.

  • You will ensure that all work is carried out efficiently, safely, and with particular attention to detail, while minimising disruption to our guests and hotel operations.

  • You will take on occasional on-call duty shifts to respond quickly and reliably to emergencies as they arise.

• What you bring to the job

For this highly varied position, you ideally bring the following:

  • Completed vocational training as a painter, decorator, or an equivalent professional qualification.

  • Several years of professional experience in painting, decorating, renovation, and maintenance work. Previous experience in a luxury hotel or a comparable high-standard environment is an advantage.

  • Strong technical knowledge of painting and decorating techniques, surface preparation, coatings, materials, and finishes, combined with a high standard of craftsmanship.

  • Good command of German as well as spoken Italian; knowledge of English is an advantage.

  • A responsible, reliable, and independent working style, with excellent attention to detail and a strong commitment to maintaining the highest quality standards.

  • A professional and discreet approach, particularly when working in guest-facing areas and occupied spaces, with consideration for our guests and hotel operations at all times.

  • A flexible and solution-oriented mindset, together with the ability to remain reliable and efficient during busy periods.

Our offer

  • Permanent full-time position in St. Moritz.

  • Average 5-day working week with 43.5 working hours.

  • 5 weeks of vacation and 6 public holidays per year.

  • 13th salary from the start date (pro rata temporis).

  • Meals available in our new and modern staff restaurant.

jobs.description:
Your key responsibilities

  • Supporting the Restaurant Manager in leading the service team at Paradiso Mountain Club, you will help oversee the daily operations of one of St. Moritz’s most distinctive mountain dining destinations.

  • You will coordinate daily restaurant operations both in the lounge and in the club, ensuring outstanding service and smooth operational performance.

  • Creating memorable guest experiences through warm hospitality, personalised service and attention to detail will be at the heart of your role.

  • Working closely with the Restaurant Manager, kitchen and service teams, you will help maintain the highest standards of food and beverage presentation and service delivery.

  • You will support the recruitment, training and development of the service team, fostering engagement, strong performance and consistent service excellence.

  • Close collaboration with the Events team and other hotel departments will ensure the successful delivery of private functions, special occasions and events at Paradiso Mountain Club.

  • Supporting the Restaurant Manager with operational reporting, cost control, budgeting and forecasting will contribute to the continued success of the outlet.


• What you bring to the job

  • Proven management experience ideally gained in a fast-paced environment with the highest service standards.

  • A confident, polished and service-oriented personality, combined with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • A genuine passion for luxury hospitality and creating personalised guest experiences of the highest standard.

  • Strong organisational skills, commercial awareness and the ability to remain calm and solution-oriented in a dynamic, fast-paced mountain environment.

  • A hands-on approach, flexibility and the ability to work closely with the Restaurant Manager and the wider operational team.

  • Fluency in English is essential. Either German or Italian is also required.


Our offer

  • Permanent position in the unique setting of Paradiso Mountain Club.

  • Five-day working week, averaging 43.5 hours, with five weeks of annual leave and six public holidays per year.

  • 13th-month salary from the start of employment, paid pro rata.

  • Accommodation in one of our modern staff residences at the beginning of your employment.

  • Staff meals provided during working hours.

  • An inspiring working environment with opportunities for professional development and career progression.

If you are passionate about delivering exceptional guest experiences and enjoy supporting and leading a team in a dynamic luxury mountain setting, we look forward to receiving your complete online application.
